threads.body: This adds v5 alongside v4 rather than performing the advertised upgrade. The Echo workload still imports `github.com/labstack/echo/v4` (`echo/scenarios/server.go:10`), and its conformance metadata still identifies v4, so all scenarios continue exercising v4 while v5 remains unused. Replace the v4 dependency and migrate those call sites/metadata to v5 (including its pointer-based `Context` API).

replies.body: Fixed: the workload uses Echo v5 and `*echo.Context`, and the conformance metadata identifies Echo v5. Instrumentation now uses `github.com/labstack/echo-otel/v5`; the v4 dependency and v4-only `otelecho` middleware are removed.
